name: How long does it take to build a custom tiny home?
description: Building a custom tiny home typically takes 3 to 6 months. The design phase adds another 4-8 weeks before construction begins.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a custom tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The construction timeline for a custom tiny home typically ranges from 3 to 6 months from the start of fabrication. This timeframe can vary depending on the complexity of the design, material availability, and client-requested customizations. The design phase, which precedes construction, usually takes an additional 4-8 weeks to finalize plans and secure necessary approvals. We work closely with you to set realistic expectations and provide regular updates throughout the building process.
